summary_1line: Indra praises Bali’s understanding of Time’s power, then Bhishma recounts how Lakshmi abandoned the morally decayed Asuras and chose the virtuous gods.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra stands before the bound Asura Bali, thunderbolt raised, while Bali remains calm despite the glowing nooses of Varuna around him.
The radiant goddess Lakshmi descends from the sky on a blazing celestial vehicle, surrounded by Apsaras, appearing like a second sun before Indra and Narada.
Indra and the sage Narada stand at the river Ganga at dawn, hymning the rising sun as golden light spreads across the water.
